scope: Post-candidate deterministic diagnostic. It may reject a candidate for a reproducible shortcut, but passing it does not establish neural-model difficulty.

question_to_evidence_bm25.candidate_pool: all public spans in the same match
question_to_evidence_bm25.retrieval_budget: exactly the gold positive evidence span count for that question

question_only_topology_prior.predictor: Jaccard 1-nearest-neighbour over public question text; deterministic lexical tie break
question_only_topology_prior.claim_boundary: Relation counts contain no span endpoints. Even an exact signature cannot earn an exact typed edge under the official scorer without recovering the correct public span IDs and directions.

public_numeric_level_confound.predictor: standardized 1-nearest-neighbour over public-only length, corpus-size, marker-position and lexical-score features
public_numeric_level_confound.required_control_if_failed: Retain and report equal cross-level-anchor weighting; do not interpret an unadjusted level curve causally.
public_numeric_level_confound.claim_boundary: Predicting the private level does not recover facts or evidence, but it can confound interpretation of the five-level curve.

decision_policy.on_any_failed_shortcut_gate: Do not run external models. Reproduce the failure on 220 streamed matches and build a new candidate only if it persists and a semantics-preserving repair exists.
decision_policy.on_all_shortcut_gates_pass: Freeze R26.14. Carry descriptive risks into Sentinel5 error analysis; do not create R26.15 solely to lower a descriptive diagnostic.
